# aether_organization (Resource)

The settings of the provider's organization. Organizations are created at registration, so this resource cannot create one: import it (`terraform import aether_organization.<name> <organization id>`). Destroy only forgets the organization; it is never deleted. Removing `name`, `billing_email` or `vat_id` from the configuration stops managing it and keeps the stored value; set it to `""` to clear it (`name` cannot be cleared).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Import-only: this resource cannot create an organization (see the import command below).
# The slug cannot be changed from Terraform; "" clears an optional field.
resource "aether_organization" "this" {
  name          = "Example Ltd"
  billing_email = "billing@example.com"
  vat_id        = "FI12345678"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `billing_email` (String) Address invoices are sent to. `""` clears it.
- `name` (String) Display name of the organization. Must not be empty.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe organization identifier (3-63 characters: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen). It cannot be changed through Terraform: registry projects, storage billing and quota are keyed on it, and a rename would strand them for existing clusters (aether-api #303). Rename in the portal instead.
- `vat_id` (String) VAT identification number. `""` clears it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Organization UUID.
- `plan` (String) Legacy organization plan, always `starter`; not settable.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the organization was last written (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Organizations are created at registration; adopt yours by id (data.aether_organization exposes it).
terraform import aether_organization.this 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
# OpenTofu: tofu import aether_organization.this 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
